I'm a PhD researcher at the University of Liverpool, studying how global warming affects the reproductive success of Andean trees. My work follows trees from seed to seedling with fieldwork in the tropical Andes of Ecuador.

## Education

**PhD, University of Liverpool** \| 2025 – present

Understanding reproductive success to evaluate the impact of global warming on Andean trees

**MRes Advanced Biological Sciences, University of Liverpool** \| 2020 – 2021

Environmental, genetic and phenotypic drivers of forest resilience to climate change

**BSc Ecology & Conservation Biology, University of Sheffield** \| 2016 – 2019

## Experience

**Technical Lead – Scoring, CDP** \| 2024 – 2025

**Technical Officer – Climate Change Scoring, CDP** \| 2023 – 2024

**Disclosure Support & Scoring Officer, CDP** \| 2022 – 2023

**Environmental Sustainability Data Scorer, Incite Insight** \| 2022
